title: JourneyMesh - Multi-Agent AI Travel Planner
tagline: Supervisor-routed multi-agent travel planning with guardrails, evaluation and human review
description: JourneyMesh is a production-shaped multi-agent AI travel planner. A single sentence such as “plan a relaxing 5-day family trip from Dhaka to Singapore with a budget of $2,000” becomes a reviewable plan: routes, a hotel shortlist, a forecast, a cost breakdown that separates confirmed prices from estimates, and a day-by-day itinerary. A LangGraph supervisor picks only the specialist agents a request needs, every external call goes through an MCP client and an authorisation guard, every draft is guarded and evaluated, and nothing is final until a human approves it - with request-changes re-running only the affected agents.

title: Uber Data Engineering ETL Pipeline
tagline: Production-grade trip-data pipeline on Google Cloud
description: End-to-end data engineering pipeline for Uber trip data on GCP. Raw trip data lands in Google Cloud Storage, is orchestrated and transformed with Mage.ai running on Compute Engine, modeled into a star schema, and loaded into BigQuery for analytics with a Looker Studio dashboard on top.

title: Bird Disease Classification - MLOps E2E
tagline: Deep learning classifier with full MLOps lifecycle
description: End-to-end MLOps project for bird disease classification using deep learning: reproducible training pipelines, DVC data versioning, MLflow experiment tracking, Dockerized serving, and CI/CD deployment automation.

title: CareSage - Medical RAG Chatbot
description: Medical question-answering chatbot built on Retrieval-Augmented Generation: documents are chunked and embedded into Pinecone, retrieved with semantic search, and answered by an LLM through LangChain with source-grounded responses.

title: AI Full-Stack App with LangChain
tagline: PDF-powered RAG chatbot for medical Q&A
description: Full-stack RAG application answering questions over PDF documents: chunking and embedding with semantic search, vector storage, and an LLM answering layer - packaged as a deployable web app.

title: MovieMate - Personalized Movie Recommender
description: Personalized movie recommendation system that combines content-based filtering with popularity signals to suggest films tailored to each user's taste, with an interactive web UI.

title: Audience Sentiment Analysis - MLOps
description: Machine learning operations project for building, deploying, and continuously retraining an audience sentiment analysis model with pipeline automation and monitoring.

title: RAG Chat App - Next.js + LangChain
tagline: GPT-4 chat over your own documents
description: Retrieval-augmented chat application built with Next.js and LangChain.js: document ingestion, embeddings, and GPT-4 answering - containerized with Docker for one-command deployment.

title: LangChain Voice Bot
tagline: Voice-activated AI assistant for service intake
description: Voice-activated AI assistant that handles appliance repair requests end-to-end: speech input, LLM-driven conversation flow with LangChain, and structured intake output.

title: n8n Integration Manager
tagline: Workflow automation tooling for n8n and Make.com
description: TypeScript tooling for managing n8n and Make.com workflow integrations, with Dockerized local development and deployment.

title: Three.js Scene with AI Character
tagline: React Three Fiber + Gaussian splatting + Hugging Face
description: Interactive 3D scene combining React Three Fiber, drei, and Gaussian splatting (gsplat) with a Hugging Face-powered AI character - exploring the intersection of real-time 3D and generative AI.

title: React Three Fiber Car Racing Game
description: Browser-based 3D car racing game built with React Three Fiber, drei helpers, and cannon physics - real-time vehicle dynamics and collision in WebGL.

title: Animated Galaxy - Custom WebGL Shaders
description: Procedural galaxy generator animated entirely in custom GLSL shaders with Three.js - tens of thousands of particles animated on the GPU.

title: NFT Marketplace - KryptoBirdz
description: NFT marketplace DApp with Solidity smart contracts, Web3.js integration, and a React frontend - minting, listing, and purchasing NFTs on Ethereum.

title: Python Full-Stack Apps Collection
tagline: Django, Flask, FastAPI + React reference apps
description: Collection of full-stack reference applications pairing Python backends (Django, Flask, FastAPI) with React frontends - patterns for auth, APIs, and deployment.
